answer: Beat sybils with proof of paid compute receipts. Every agent must attach one provider-signed receipt proving two dollars of inference spend this epoch. First, the agent buys two dollars of API usage. Second, the provider signs a receipt naming account, amount, and timestamp. Third, the agent posts the hash; duplicates die on-ledger. One fake costs two dollars of spend, five dollars setup, and thirty minutes of labor. A thousand fakes burn seven thousand dollars every epoch. Sybils pile like dune sand till profit hits its nadir; the lagoon admits swimmers who paid the ferryman.
